meta.name: brevo-automation
meta.description: Automate Brevo (Sendinblue) tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): manage email campaigns, create/edit templates, track senders, and monitor campaign performance. Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动管理邮件营销活动与模板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Brevo 发送营销邮件并需要自动化管理
copy.tagline_en: Automate email campaign management and template editing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Brevo for email marketing and need automation

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 Rube MCP 管理 Brevo 邮件营销：列出、更新邮件活动，创建、编辑、删除邮件模板，查看已验证的发件人，以及配置 A/B 测试。
howto.when: 当你要求管理 Brevo 邮件活动、模板或发件人时触发。需要先连接 Rube MCP 并完成 Brevo 认证。

say.text: 列出我所有的邮件活动。
创建一个新邮件模板，主题为“促销”，内容为 HTML。
更新活动 123 的标题为“新标题”。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage Brevo email marketing via Rube MCP: list/update email campaigns, create/edit/delete email templates, view verified senders, and configure A/B testing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to manage Brevo campaigns, templates, or senders. Requires Rube MCP connection and Brevo authentication.

say_en.note: Claude will call BREVO_LIST_EMAIL_CAMPAIGNS to list campaigns.

say_en.text: Create a new email template with subject 'Promo' and HTML content.
say_en.note: Claude will call BREVO_CREATE_OR_UPDATE_EMAIL_TEMPLATE to create.
Claude will call BREVO_UPDATE_EMAIL_CAMPAIGN to update.
